hypothesis: Learning input directions may improve in-range capability yet still fail outside the training range.
design: Freeze models/checkpoints35/37.5 seeds,1024 fresh inputs per seed,range multipliers1/1.5/2/3. Recompute labels from the unchanged analytic task at the new input; this is domain extrapolation, not noisy observation of the old input.
metrics: Accuracy and balanced accuracy plus majority baseline, since radial labels become imbalanced when the domain grows. Exact expectations isolate representation error; no finite-shot or gate noise here.
limits: Chosen analytic tasks,not natural real-world data. Shared base points across scales are paired,not independent. No model selection or fitting on extrapolation labels.
